headline: Exchange CEO forced to issue clarifying statement after accidentally joining Tata Sons boardroom for lunch
body:
The National Stock Exchange’s chief executive officer was forced to issue a formal clarification on Wednesday after accidentally wandering into the Tata Sons executive boardroom during a routine lunch break, leading many to believe he was a potential candidate for the chairman’s post. Witnesses reported that the CEO, who had intended to find the staff canteen, spent forty-five minutes discussing the quality of the office curd rice with several board members who were too polite to ask why he was sitting at the head of the table.

“It was an honest misunderstanding involving a poorly marked floor directory and a desperate craving for premium cafeteria catering,” said a spokesperson for the exchange. “He merely sat down, asked if the papadum was included in the daily rotation, and proceeded to check his emails while the board discussed quarterly strategy. He was neither auditioning for the role nor attempting a hostile takeover of the menu.”

The confusion reached a fever pitch after a junior analyst tweeted a grainy photo of the CEO’s empty chair next to a plate of half-eaten gulab jamun, leading to wild speculation about an imminent leadership transition. The exchange has since confirmed that the CEO returned to his own office by 2:00 PM, fully satisfied with the lunch but completely unaware of his sudden status as a corporate frontrunner.

When asked about the incident, the CEO reportedly sighed and noted that while the corporate strategy at the neighboring office was impressive, the lack of sufficient green chutney made the position entirely untenable. He has requested that all future building management updates include clearer signage to distinguish between the executive dining halls and the regular employee cafeteria.
caption: When you accidentally crash a high-stakes board meeting just for the lunch menu. #TataSons #NSE #CorporateLife #LunchBreak (satire)
